Meanwhile, the Forresters discuss how to handle the Ambrosia line while Amber is in detox. They're surprised when Thorne points out that the Spectra fashion show is the same day as theirs. Rick suggests they get someone inside Spectra to see what they're up to, and wants Kristen to snoop around when she's visiting Tony. Kristen finally gives into the family pressure and agrees. Kristen hears Massimo's voice and wonders why Tony is meeting with him. She is stunned when she walks in and sees Ridge there as well.

Ridge covers, explaining that he stopped by to visit Tony, but Kristen is still suspicious. Tony informs Kristen that Ridge bought Spectra. Kristen realizes that Tony and Ridge are in cahoots with Massimo, and that Ridge and Sally are out for revenge against Rick and Brooke. Kristen assures them that by tomorrow, their secret will be all over the industry. Ridge urges Kristen not to tell the family. Sheila asks for Ziggy's help in convincing Erica to go after Rick. Erica resists being more aggressive, but Sheila and Ziggy give her a demonstration of how to act around Rick. Erica is furious with her mother, and leaves. Sheila is happy to see that Erica is her mother's daughter. Rick wants to make sure Amber has Brooke's support. Brooke is concerned about Little Eric being in the hands of a teenage nanny, but angers Rick when she suggests that there's something attractive about Erica. Rick admits to Amber that he desperately wants to see her and heads to the clinic.

Sheila arranges for Erica to have a makeover. She promises that tonight is going to be special for Erica & Rick. Erica refuses to take any part in breaking up Rick & Amber's marriage. Sheila convinces Erica to go over to the house because Rick will need a friend. Ziggy is sure that Sheila was somehow involved with Forrester Creations, but a search turns up no Sheila Lovejoy on the employee lists. He is stunned when he finds out that she was once married to Eric. Ziggy continues his search and finds info about Sheila's marriage to James, their daughter Mary and Sheila's police record. Rick encourages Amber, expresses to her how much he misses her. He suggests they take advantage of her roommate's absence, but Amber isn't ready to make love. Ziggy bursts in, telling Erica that Sheila is a wanted criminal, unaware that Sheila is in the apartment, not Erica. Amber tearfully explains to Caitlyn that she let her husband down again, that he needs his wife.

Sheila warns Ziggy that if he says a word to the cops, he will just disappear, no one will ever find the body. Ziggy realizes that Sheila is still hung up on Eric, that's why she stayed in L.A. Sheila explains that her daughter deserves the best, if Rick is anything like his father she'll do everything she can to get them together. Bridget invites Stephanie to a baby shower for Brooke. Stephanie isn't sure that Brooke would want her there, but Bridget insists. Rick expresses his concern about the Ambrosia line, whatever it is Sally is up to. Erica encourages him to relax, pours him another drink. After Rick heads up to bed, Erica is giddy, realizing that her mother's coaching worked. Deacon agrees with Brooke that they've taken too many chances, they have to put that part of their lives behind them. Stephanie warns Brooke that if Bridget ever finds out the truth, Brooke will feel Stephanie's wrath like never before.

Whip explains to Deacon that this is the end of the line for him because there is no way Brooke would betray Bridget now. Deacon insists that Whip is only delaying the inevitable. After the baby shower, Bridget expresses to Brooke how proud she of her, and how happy she is that the tension between them has disappeared. Erica listens from downstairs on the newly installed baby monitor. Brooke and Bridget embrace. Relieved that everything seems to be settled, Stephanie tells Brooke that she and Whip are going to give the baby an excellent life. Megan assures Whip that Deacon won't do anything to jeopardize his relationship with Bridget, and that it's completely over between Deacon and Brooke. Deacon is looking for Bridget when he sees Brooke in the nursery. Bridget hears their voices on the monitor and stops to listen. Deacon notes to Brooke that she and the baby deserve better than Whip. Bridget is shocked when Deacon insists that Whip will never love Brooke as much as he does.

As Bridget listens to Brooke & Deacon's conversation, she becomes more curious, wonders what Brooke's marriage has to do with her. Deacon tries to convince Brooke that if they're going to get over the past, they need to clear the air. Bridget is horrified when Deacon tells Brooke that he'll never regret making love to her. Bridget collapses after she hears Brooke say that Bridget can never find out that she's pregnant with Deacon's baby. Ridge & Taylor make love in his office. Whip is encouraged when he hears how well the party went, explains to Megan that Brooke has to see that marrying him was the best decision she ever made. Megan advises Whip not to push Brooke because it may take her time to realize what a great guy he is. Whip is certain that if they can keep a lid on things until after the baby's born, he & Brooke will be able to go on with their lives. Whip admits to Megan that if Bridget discovers the truth, she may never be able to trust anyone again.

Bridget refuses to explain to Eric what's wrong and is horrified when he offers to call Brooke for her. When Stephanie discovers that Bridget is hysterical and doesn't want to talk to Brooke, she fears the worst. When Bridget hears Stephanie's voice, she puts it together that Stephanie was in on the secret too. Stephanie finally convinces Bridget to open the door. Bridget glares at Stephanie, and blasts her for not being honest with her. She says that Stephanie was right about Brooke being a whore. Stephanie holds Bridget as she sobs and promises that she's not going to let this destroy Bridget. Brooke assures Whip that seeing Bridget so happy at the shower makes everything worthwhile. She knows she did the right thing by marrying Whip, and says that Deacon realizes it, too. Brooke wonders where Bridget is, but isn't terribly concerned until she hears Whip chatting with Erica on the baby monitor up in the nursery. Brooke starts to panic when she realizes what may have happened.

Bridget wants to know how Stephanie could have helped Brooke and Deacon deceive her. She asks Stephanie how Deacon and Brooke got together in the first place when Brooke seemed to hate Deacon so much. Bridget is disgusted at the thought that Deacon's child is inside of Brooke. She notes to Stephanie that she's not going to be able to look at the baby. Deacon explains to Megan that it would ruin Bridget's life if she found out the truth, and he couldn't live with that. He plans to give Bridget the life and the marriage she deserves. Brooke is horrified when Whip explains that he and Erica were talking in the nursery when she heard them. She reveals that she and Deacon talked about the baby and Bridget when they were together in the nursery. Whip and Brooke question Erica, trying to figure out who might have overheard Brooke's conversation with Deacon. When they realize Bridget had been there, Brooke admits to Whip that if Bridget heard them talking, then she knows everything.

Brooke is frantically trying to locate Bridget when Eric alerts her that he saw her at the house, she was very upset. Brooke rushes out to see her, but tells Deacon not to come along. Stephanie suggests that Bridget should forget about Brooke, never speak to her again, but Bridget insists that she's not going to let Brooke off that easily. Stephanie suggests that Bridget stay with her until she's strong enough to face them. Whip asks Deacon to do Brooke & Bridget a favor and get out of their lives, something he should have done months ago. Deacon is worried that Stephanie will be mad enough to kill Brooke. While Bridget is out for a walk, Eric lets Stephanie know that Brooke is on her way over. Brooke is in tears as she heads over, worried that she's too late and has lost her daughter. Brooke searches for Bridget, certain she is there. Stephanie finally admits that Bridget knows. She grabs Brooke by the throat, orders her to leave Bridget alone.

Whip angrily wonders why Deacon couldn't have kept his mouth shut. He warns Deacon that, with Stephanie there, Brooke could be walking into an ambush.  Stephanie comes out of her fantasy about strangling Brooke. Covering her rage when Brooke arrives, Stephanie informs Brooke that Bridget went to Big Bear with some friends, makes up a story about why Bridget was upset. She assures Brooke that there's nothing to worry about. When Brooke is gone, Stephanie promises that Brooke will pay for what she's done to Bridget. After they have pizza with Erica, Rick takes Little Eric up to bed. Erica reveals to Rick that she loves her job, she's the luckiest girl in the world after Amber. Erica is thrilled when Rick offers to let her try on a Forrester original. Erica looks stunning when she comes down the stairs in one of Amber's gowns. Brooke calls Deacon, explains Bridget is all right, but they have to be careful from now on. Bridget is anxious to confront Brooke, asks Stephanie where she went.

Stephanie informs Massimo that Bridget will be staying with them for awhile. Stephanie promises she will take care of Bridget while she sorts things out. Stephanie explains the whole story to Massimo, and he wonders how Bridget will ever recover. Stephanie is determined to save Bridget from Brooke's treachery. Once she knows Bridget is all right, Stephanie plans to take care of Brooke. Stephanie is sure Brooke cannot undo the damage she's done to her relationship with her daughter. Bridget cries as she recalls her wedding day. She feels betrayed by the two people she trusted the most. Brooke admits to Deacon that she should feel completely relieved, but for some reason, she doesn't. She wonders why Bridget hasn't called. Erica is giddy with excitement wearing the Forrester gown. She and Rick dance together. Erica tells Rick about her mother, and agrees when Rick says that her mother would be proud if she could see Erica now. Erica confesses to Rick that she has a crush on him.

The more Bridget thinks about Brooke's lies, the more furious she gets. Stephanie assures Bridget that she'll get her chance to confront Brooke, but she won't allow her to tonight. Stephanie urges Bridget to calm down, talk to Taylor before she sees her mother. Brooke decides to drive up to Big Bear to make sure Bridget is all right, that their secret is safe. Kristen expresses her concern to Eric about the risk they're taking by putting all of their energy into Amber's line. Eric asks about Ridge's job, Taylor responds that he has been involved in acquisitions for Marone Industries. Eric is sure that, with Ridge involved, the merger will be a success. Kristen has agreed to keep the secret, but adds that she and Eric are going to give their collection their best effort. Brooke calls Deacon from the cabin and informs him that Bridget hasn't been there. Brooke is sure that something is very wrong. Bridget calls and tells Brooke to wait there for her.

Stephanie drives Bridget up to the cabin, but tries unsuccessfully to change Bridget's mind about confronting Brooke. Bridget insists upon talking to Brooke alone. Stephanie is certain that Bridget will survive this, but isn't so sure about Brooke. Deacon & Megan can't imagine what would have happened if Bridget had heard his conversation with Brooke. Deacon explains that he plans to leave town before the baby's born. Brooke asks Bridget about her friend, tells Bridget how concerned she was when Bridget was missing. Bridget wants to talk about how much she means to Brooke, who insists she's closer to Bridget than anyone on earth. Bridget talks about the effect Brooke's life has had on her life, how Bridget would always worry about Brooke as she went through her latest heartbreak. Bridget explains to Brooke that she realized today that all the terrible things people have said about Brooke were right. Brooke is shocked when Bridget admits that she knows the truth.

Whip is surprised when Deacon agrees to stay away from Brooke. He explains that he's planning to take Bridget on a publicity tour for the Ambrosia line. Whip assures Deacon that the baby will be surrounded with love from the day he's born. Bridget demands to know how many times Deacon & Brooke were together and where. Brooke tries to convince Bridget how important she's always been to her. Bridget insists that Brooke threw her away but Brooke swears that she tried to do the right thing. Bridget tells Brooke that she made her choice, choices have consequences. One is a child coming into her life, the other is a child walking out of her life and never looking back. Brooke grabs Bridget's wrist. She begs her not to leave and to give her another chance. Stephanie emerges and orders Brooke to let Bridget go. Bridget admits that she may forgive Brooke someday, but she'll never trust her. Bridget leaves, and Brooke drops to her knees. Panicked, she informs Stephanie that she's in labor.

Bridget calls the hospital, but is told it will take at least an hour for the ambulance to reach them. Stephanie doesn't want Brooke to have the baby in front of Bridget and tries to get her to the car. As another contraction hits, Brooke tells Stephanie that she's having the baby here and now, whether she likes it or not. Stephanie wants to leave Brooke with the caretaker until the doctor arrives rather than subject Bridget to any more trauma, but Bridget says that she will help Stephanie deliver the baby. Brooke apologizes to Bridget and says that she never meant to hurt her. Sally is overwhelmed with joy when she sees C.J. They embrace. C.J. is pleased to hear that things are going well at Spectra, but is stunned when Ridge walks in on them. C.J. is horrified when he realizes Sally sold Spectra to Ridge Forrester. C.J. swears that he will never work for a Forrester, and slams out. Ridge notices Massimo's preoccupation and wants to know what's going on with Stephanie and Brooke.

On the eve of her release from the rehab facility, Rick informs Thorne that one of the tabloids is going to run a story about Amber's addiction and treatment. Thorne wonders if Rick & Amber are ready to face one of the biggest scandals they've ever seen. He reminds Rick that recovery is an ongoing process, it's a challenge for the addict, everyone who cares about them. Rick had assumed rehab would make her better. Rick's troubled by what Thorne said, but thanks him for his straightforwardness. Rick is stunned when Amber explains that she wants to stay alone in the guest house for a few weeks. With Stephanie & Bridget trying to help, Brooke gives birth to a baby girl. She asks for a moment alone with Bridget and reminds her that, regardless of how Bridget feels about Brooke, this innocent baby is her half-sister. When Bridget hands the baby back, she tells Brooke to take her only daughter. Bridget reveals to Brooke that she'll never forgive her, but she doesn't hate her.

Deacon goes over the itinerary with Megan, explains that he's going to take Bridget to all of the most romantic places in the world. He & Brooke are putting their secret behind them because it's time to move on. Amber tells him it's clear that he's not ready to deal with her recovery, she doesn't want to burden him with her problems. Rick welcomes Amber home, they embrace. Bridget informs Brooke that she's been humiliated for the last time, she won't let the scandal poison the family, too. Brooke begs Bridget not to cut her out of her life, but Bridget assures Brooke that they're through with each other. The doctor explains to Brooke that she & her baby are in perfect health. Stephanie tells Brooke that she has to give this baby a normal life, but she has to change everything. For the baby's sake, Stephanie agrees to help Brooke. Deacon is shocked when Bridget says that he & Brooke have a healthy baby daughter.

Bridget confronts Deacon with everything she knows. She gathers up his things and heads outside. Deacon is stunned when she puts his clothes in a barrel, pours his bourbon over them, ignites them. When they see fireworks, Bridget reminds him it's the fourth of July, she's celebrating her independence from him. Thorne confesses to Eric that he's worried about Brooke. Eric isn't happy to hear about Deacon's plan to take Bridget on a publicity tour around the world. Thorne assures Eric that it's just a matter of time until Bridget sees Deacon for who he really is. Stephanie lets Brooke & the baby stay in the guest house until she's ready to face her family. Stephanie notes to Brooke that the baby needs her more than anyone ever has. Brooke needs to build a new life for the baby's sake, Stephanie's going to help her. Stephanie points out to Brooke that Deacon can't offer her daughter anything but scandal and shame, but Brooke refuses to cut Deacon out of her life.

The Forresters are shocked to learn that their new line has been dropped by most of the buyers, and when Rick, Amber, and Thorne go to Spectra to see Lauren about it, they find Ridge, who reminds him that he told them to watch their backs.

Rick & Thorne are stunned when they realize that Ridge took over Spectra with Massimo's assistance. Ridge suggests that Rick cancel their fashion show because if no one is carrying their line, the press won't show up. Amber tells Ridge that he doesn't deserve the name Forrester. Ridge assures Amber that none of this would have happened if not for her. Kristen breaks the news to Eric that Ridge is behind the Spectra situation. Eric is furious, and can't believe Kristen's assertion that Ridge is doing this for Eric, especially when it has cost Eric his marriage and pitted his children against each other. Bridget fills out an application to work as a waitress at Insomnia, but C.J. snatches it away. Bridget insists that she needs a job to pay her rent, but C.J. is duly skeptical. C.J. calls Bridget a brat and orders her to get out. Bridget thinks C.J. is still bitter because Amber chose Rick instead of him. C.J. hires Bridget, but spills some coffee on the floor and says to clean it up.

Deacon hears that Brooke and the baby are staying in the guesthouse, slips out of the office. C.J. enjoys the power he has over Bridget, warns her that she has to earn her money. Bridget informs C.J. that her marriage is over, she never wants to see Deacon again. Brooke admits to Stephanie how much she misses Bridget. Stephanie advises Brooke to forget about Deacon and her loveless marriage, to focus on Bridget and the baby. Deacon is entranced when he sees his baby daughter, holds her. Brooke reminds him that no one can ever know that he is the baby's father. Stephanie assures Deacon that she is going to help Brooke raise the baby. Eric stops production on the Ambrosia line, gives Thorne instructions to try to get their buyers back. Thorne tells Eric that the buyers have said that they're passing on the Ambrosia line and staying loyal to Ridge, while Kristen informs them that the warehouses are overflowing. Eric realizes that Forrester is in deep trouble.

Tony is not as enthusiastic as Sally, Clarke & Ridge are about their coup. He tries to make Ridge see the impact their actions will have on his family. Thorne notes to Eric that Ridge is consumed with bitterness and hatred, wants Forrester to fail. Brooke reminds Deacon that, in spite of the baby, they can't be together because Bridget means too much to her. Deacon realizes that Brooke wants Bridget back and promises to stay away. He tells Brooke that he'll never regret what they shared. He asks Brooke not to forget their relationship, and not to regret it too much, adding that it was the best thing in his life. Amber apologizes to Erica for the way she treated her and thanks her for everything. They embrace. When Erica says that she bought her outfit from Telesave, Rick realizes they could sell their inventory on TV and try to recoup their losses. He pitches the idea to Kristen, Thorne and Eric, but Eric insists they'll sell Forrester clothes on TV over his dead body.

Ridge admits to Stephanie that he's happy to hear that Bridget is free of that slimeball Deacon. Ridge explains that once Forrester is shut down, Eric can finally be free of Brooke. Sally assures C.J. that Brooke & Thorne are about to get what's coming to them, Sally wants C.J. there to see it. C.J. insists that Ridge is just using Sally, but Sally is sure that Spectra is going to flatten Forrester before they know what hit them. Eric informs Brooke that Ridge convinced all their distributors to replace their line with his. Rick wants to talk to the people at Telesave, a cable shopping channel, but Eric refuses to ruin the Forrester reputation. Brooke begs Ridge not to rob her children, especially her new baby, of their legacy. Ridge asks if Brooke thought of his children when she fired him. Ridge is sorry that it's come to this, but Sally joins them, says that she's been waiting for this moment for years.

Rick & Amber try unsuccessfully to convince Eric to change his mind about selling their inventory on Telesave. Eric tells Kristen that if they put the collection up for sale on television, everything Forrester stands for will be wiped out. Sally warns Brooke that with Ridge & Massimo on her side, she has the power to make Brooke & her family suffer as much pain& loss as she has. Erica thinks that her days as Little Eric's nanny are limited now that Amber is healthy, but Sheila insists that Erica's future is with Rick, and Erica has to stay focused. Erica doesn't want to bother Amber and Rick and adds that sometimes she thinks Sheila is psycho. Amber and Rick go to the Telesave studios and ask the producer if he would be interested in adding their collection to his product line. Brooke is determined to do battle with Spectra and decides to sell the line on Telesave despite Eric's objections. Sally informs Tony that tomorrow they're going to bring Forrester Creations to its knees.

When Bridget doesn't bother to defend Brooke's actions, C.J. realizes Bridget is really upset with her mother, tries to draw her out. Ridge is pleased with his elegant collection, Massimo congratulates him. Ridge thanks Tony & Clarke for their help. Massimo assures Ridge that without him, Forrester is destined for bankruptcy. Ridge adds that no one will have to take orders from Brooke & her children again. Brooke informs Whip that she needs to make a lot of changes in her life. He's disappointed when she tells him that she wants to end their marriage. Bridget apologizes for snapping at C.J., but he wonders if it's a good idea for her to be working there. When he hears that Bridget doesn't have a place to live, he offers her the apartment upstairs. When Ridge calls, Rick puts him on the speakerphone. They all listen as Ridge taunts Rick about their line, assures Rick that he's finished in this business. When Amber hangs up, Eric agrees to let them sell the line on Telesave.
Eric considers partnering with Ridge.
Amber and Rick celebrate their success with the Telesave telethon.
Taylor comforts Ridge after Eric makes his decision.

Brooke announces that yesterday was the single most profitable day in the history of Forrester Creations. Eric admits that the press is accusing Forrester of selling out, but thanks everyone for giving Forrester the future they almost didn't have. When Erica stops by, Rick thanks her, tells everyone that she gave him the idea of selling their line on Telesave in the first place. Meanwhile, the Spectra fashion show was a smashing success, but Ridge clearly isn't as thrilled as the others. Sally admits to Ridge that she finally has the respect she always dreamed of. Taylor assures Ridge that he totally restored his reputation with last night's fashion show. Lance, an out-of-work model, goes with Ziggy while he's making some repairs at Sheila's apartment. Amber professes her love to Rick, promises that she'll never do anything to hurt the company or him again. Erica is excited about going to Rick's party, but informs her mother she won't do anything to mess with Rick's marriage.

Sheila offers Lance ten thousand dollars if he'll get Caitlyn, one of the Forrester models, to invite him to the Forrester party as part of Sheila's plot against Amber. Bridget declines Rick's invitation to the party when she hears that Brooke might be there. Rick is furious when he finds out that Bridget left Deacon because he cheated on her. Rick asks C.J. to keep an eye on Bridget. Amber promises Thorne that she won't let Rick down again. Erica refuses to chase after Rick, but Sheila wonders how Erica would feel if she found out that Amber wasn't as perfect for Rick as she thought. Lance arranges to go to the party with Caitlyn. When Sheila hears, she is pleased that her plan to ruin Amber's marriage is underway. As they get ready for the party, Rick tells Amber that they've made it through the bad times, and now it's time to celebrate the good.

Sheila shows Lance how to slip the pills into Amber's drink. Stephanie notes how much Bridget has grown up in the past few weeks and tells Bridget she's proud of her. Eric toasts the success of the Ambrosia line. Amber and Rick kiss as Erica watches. Rick announces that it was Erica who gave him the idea to sell the line on Telesave. Amber sets down her drink and moves to Rick's side as Rick makes a speech about Amber's accomplishments. Lance slips the pills into Amber's glass of wine. Rick and Amber kiss, then Amber retrieves her glass. Sheila notes to Ziggy that Rick is the kind of man that Erica deserves, and the man she's going to get. Bridget hears one of Macy's songs playing in C.J.'s room. C.J. sadly recalls his wedding to Becky, then looks up to find Bridget watching him sympathetically.

Amber acknowledges everyone's contributions to the line's success. When Thorne questions her, Erica admits that she has a little crush on Rick, but quickly adds that she admires Amber, respects their marriage. Ziggy wonders what Sheila is up to. Sheila only says that Amber stole her future, but she's not going to let her ruin Erica's. Bridget sees that C.J. is crying, tries to comfort him, but C.J. angrily orders her to leave. Lance calls Sheila, informs her that the pills aren't working, but then he sees Amber stumble a bit. Lance approaches Amber, who falls into his arms as she passes out. Erica sees them, hurries off, thinking she's interrupted a private moment. Lance carries Amber away, but calls Sheila to make sure the drugs won't hurt her. Rick is looking for Amber, but Erica doesn't reveal what she just witnessed. C.J. apologizes for yelling at Bridget. He admits how much he misses Macy & Becky, finally opens up to Bridget about how their deaths have affected him.

Rick informs Erica that Amber never came home last night. Erica finally confesses that she saw Amber, she wasn't alone. When Rick questions her, Erica admits that Amber and the model were holding each other. Rick wonders if Amber had more than one glass of wine, but can't believe that Amber spent the night with another man. Amber is horrified when she realizes she was there all night, when Lance reminds her that she got drunk and came on to him. Amber is distraught, believes that she betrayed Rick. She takes a cab home and rushes in, apologizing to Rick. Sheila is pleased to hear that Amber was out all night. Ziggy wants to know what Sheila asked Lance to do to Amber. Sheila just hopes that Lance is as good an actor as he claims to be. She insists that Amber brought this on herself, but Ziggy points out that Amber didn't do anything wrong. Bridget just listens as two fellow employees complain about C.J.'s moodiness. She makes eye contact with C.J. across the room.

C.J. points out that he opened up to Bridget, now he wants to know what's been bothering her. He can tell that is has something to do with her mother. Lance picks up his money from Sheila, orders her not to call him again. Amber tries to explain herself, but Rick cuts to the chase, asks her about the guy she was seen with. Amber admits that she blacked out, then woke up in his bed. Rick explodes, wonders if she realizes what she's done. Amber swears that she would never have jeopardized everything she cares about to spend the night with a stranger, but Rick points out that she did. Amber begs for Rick's forgiveness. Brooke misses Bridget, but Stephanie says she's going to have to give Bridget more time. Brooke is stunned to hear that Bridget is working at the Insomnia. Erica informs Sheila that Amber came back, but had apparently gotten drunk and spent the night with some guy. Sheila says it proves that Amber isn't the right woman for Rick.

Amber asks Rick for one more chance. Bridget tells Brooke to stop worrying because she is taking care of herself. Brooke admits to Bridget that she misses her, but Bridget insists that it's too soon to talk. When Eric hears what Amber did, he warns Rick that Amber is on the verge of self-destruction and she could take Rick down with her. Erica notes to Sheila that she doesn't want to be a home-wrecker. Sheila responds that if Amber doesn't respect her marriage to Rick, then why should Erica. Amber informs Rick that she's leaving, assuming he'll be relieved if he never has to deal with her problems again. She realizes that he needs a break and promises to call when she gets settled. Rick rushes after her when she walks out, and finds the wedding ring she left behind. Brooke asks C.J. why he hired Bridget and wonders if it's part of some plan to get back at Brooke. Erica confesses to Sheila how hard it is to see Rick hurting, is sure that Rick and Amber will be able to work things out.

Rick admits that he could have stopped Amber, but Bridget is glad that he didn't. She thinks this could motivate Amber to get the help she needs. Bridget wants Rick to face the fact that, despite Rick and Amber's love for each other, they may not be able to work things out. Amber reveals to Taylor what happened and that her marriage is over. She cries in Taylor's arms. When Taylor hears that Amber can't remember what happened, she is sure that there is more to the story. She wants to know more about the man Amber went home with and suggests she try to track him down through Caitlyn. Taylor offers Amber the guest room while she tries to find out if Lance was telling the truth about what happened. Amber realizes it's her only chance to save her marriage. Sheila can hardly cover her glee when Erica informs her that Amber moved out. She congratulates herself for making it possible for Erica to become the next Eric Forrester Jr. Erica tells Rick how sorry she is, and embraces him.

Erica tells Rick that there's no excuse for Amber getting drunk and spending the night with a stranger. She notes that Amber was her inspiration and now she sees her throwing everything away. Erica wishes Amber had appreciated what she had. Erica knows it's possible to love someone who's no good for you, because that's the way she feels about her mother. Stephanie is disappointed when she realizes that Amber is staying with Taylor and not back at the clinic. Amber tries to explain that parts of Lance's story just don't make sense, but Stephanie thinks that Amber should be looking inside herself to explain her behavior. Over dinner, Thorne asks Brooke if she's going to cut Whip loose now. He empathizes with Whip, knowing how hard it is to get over Brooke. Caitlyn isn't very happy to hear from Amber, but she gives her Lance's phone number. Amber calls Lance and asks him to meet her at Insomnia. She informs Lance that she has some questions for him, and she wants the truth.

Erica suggests that Rick get out of the house, says they should go for coffee. C.J. notices that Bridget has been in a funk ever since she saw Brooke. Amber is sure that something is missing in Lance's story, she can tell by the look in his eyes that she's right. C.J. insists that he's not leaving until Bridget reveals what's going on. Bridget admits to C.J. that Deacon cheated on her, she doesn't think she'll ever get over it, but she won't reveal who Deacon was with. Rick is stunned when he looks across the room, spots Amber with Lance. Amber assures Lance that if he tells her the truth now, he won't get in any trouble, but she's determined to find out what really happened. Rick confronts them angrily assuming Amber left him because she couldn't wait to get back to her lover. Rick refuses to listen to Amber when she tries to explain, leaves. Erica notes to Rick that he deserves much better. Erica intervenes when Amber tries to see Rick, Amber realizes that Erica is after her husband.

Erica says that Amber betrayed Rick and wonders how she could be so ungrateful. Stephanie can't believe Amber's been given chance after chance, but keeps making terrible mistakes. Taylor is sure that there's more to what happened. Lance informs Sheila that Amber knows he's hiding something, he's going to have to tell her the truth. Sheila warns him not to double-cross her, suggests he get out of town for a couple of days. Lance wants to relocate to New York so Amber won't be waiting for him, notes to Sheila that he needs a hundred thousand dollars to cover expenses. When Sheila insists that she doesn't have the money, Lance says that he's going to have to have a little chat with Amber. Amber tries to explain that Lance is hiding something about what happened the other night, he was about to confess to Amber the truth when Rick spotted them together. Sheila assures herself that she has to do something before Lance ruins everything.

Lance calls Sheila, gives her one more chance to give him enough cash to relocate, or he'll confess everything to Amber. Wearing bee-keeping gear, Sheila notes to herself that Lance should have known better than to try to blackmail her. She gathers bees in a jar, knowing Lance is allergic to them. Sheila ties Lance's door shut, then stirs up the bees to make them angry, sends them into his apartment when he's sleeping. Lance is panic-stricken when he awakens as the bees start to sting him. Sheila whispers to Lance he messed with the wrong woman. Amber informs Taylor that Erica is after Rick. Erica is dubious when Rick comments that Amber will have proof tomorrow that this was all a misunderstanding. She reminds him that Amber has caused him enough pain, there are better women out there for him. Amber calls Rick, assures him that she is telling the truth and says not to listen to Erica.

Amber is shocked when she goes to Lance's apartment, is told that he's dead. Sheila assures Erica that it won't be long before Rick realizes how special she is. Rick admits to Brooke that he can't conceive of any reasonable explanation for Amber's behavior. He wonders how many times he can swallow his pride, forgive her. Brooke points out that taking a stand, even if it means ending his marriage, may be the right thing to do. Sheila assures Ziggy that the Forresters may never know that she's Erica's mother, but she'll have the joy of knowing that Erica & Rick are together. The police call Ziggy, inform him about what happened to Lance. Sheila denies it when Ziggy asks if she had anything to do with Lance's demise. Amber notes to Rick that she doesn't have an explanation after all because of Lance's death, but Rick is furious, doesn't want to hear any more excuses. He can't put himself in a position to be disappointed again.

Stephanie notes to Massimo that Brooke has sworn off men so she can focus on her child. Massimo has planned for the two of them to fly to Milan, then cruise the Mediterranean on his yacht. Massimo explains that if their relationship is going to progress he has to get her out of town. Stephanie wonders if this is about getting her away from Eric. Bridget informs Sally that she wants to throw C.J. a surprise party, even though he hasn't celebrated his birthday since Macy and Becky died. Bridget knows it could backfire, but she's hoping it would cheer him up. Sally thinks it's a great idea and asks what she can do to help. Brooke expresses concern about Bridget working at the Insomnia. She admits to Whip that she doesn't know what she would have done without Stephanie's help. Together, Brooke and Stephanie will give the baby the life that Brooke should have given Bridget.

Darla tries to convince C.J. that it's okay to let go of Becky's memory and move on. Clarke informs Bridget that he thinks throwing a party for C.J. is a great idea. He helps her by coming up with an excuse to get C.J. away from the coffee shop for awhile. C.J. is irked with Bridget when he sees that she booked a private party for the evening. He says that she should look for a job somewhere else. Bridget can't believe he's firing her, and admits to him that she thought they were friends. She storms off to pack her things. Sally explains to Clarke that someone like Bridget could be just what C.J. needs, but she hopes he's not too hurt and stubborn to realize it. Brooke encourages Stephanie to go on the romantic cruise with Massimo, but is grateful when Stephanie decides that she's not going anywhere.

Sally & Clarke are shocked when C.J. admits to them that he fired Bridget. Stephanie informs Massimo that she can't go away with him because of her obligation to Brooke's child. Massimo is angry, tells Stephanie he's not going to put up with her compulsive need to play savior anymore. He wanted to make a life with her, but he can't accept this situation. Bridget sets up for the party, but insists on leaving before C.J. arrives. She notes to Sally that if she wanted to be treated like dirt, she would still be married. C.J. is stunned, pleased by the surprise. Bridget watches from around the corner, gratified to see him happy. When C.J. realizes Bridget was responsible for putting the party together, he takes off looking for her. C.J. catches up with Bridget, but she is out of patience with him. Bridget tries to leave, but C.J. yanks on her suitcase, which unexpectedly throws her against his chest. They look into each other's eyes.

Kristen informs Sally that C.J. blew it and it's going to take more than an apology for him to win back Bridget's trust. C.J. pleads with Bridget not to go. She asks for a raise, and for him to be nicer to her. He takes her hand and they go back to the party. C.J. is moved when Bridget plays the video compilation of photos and video clips, from baby pictures through his wedding to Becky. Despite Bridget's protests, Kristen and Tony realize that she has it bad for C.J. Sally thinks Bridget and C.J. are good together, but Darla wonders how long it will take for them to figure that out. C.J. helps Bridget unpack and bids her goodnight. Disappointed, Massimo decides it's definitely time for a change in his life. Ziggy finds Sheila dressed up and ready to go out. Massimo is intrigued when he sees Sheila come into the bar. He approaches her table.

Massimo joins Sheila and orders them a bottle of wine. Sheila reveals that she's a single mother and her little girl has a brilliant future. Taylor and Amber wonder if Lance could have slipped something in Amber's drink, and Taylor suggests having Amber tested to see if the drug is still in her system. Amber sees it as a chance to prove to Rick that what happened wasn't her fault. Erica admits to Rick about the ways her mother influences her, and how it sometimes embarrasses her. She recalls the night her mother sent Erica over in a red dress, wanting her to seduce Rick. When Rick realizes that Sheila is living vicariously through Erica, he suggests that if she finds her mother a man of her own, she'd be too busy to worry about Erica. Erica thinks it would be hard to find a match for her mother because she is obsessive and controlling. When Amber calls to talk to Rick, Erica answers, and she refuses to put him on the line.

Bridget tells Stephanie that C.J. became bitter, cynical after Becky's death, but she thinks that's starting to change. When C.J. returns, he's in a terrible mood. He gives Bridget a hard time about not changing the coffee filters yet, then smiles to himself as she flounces off. Bridget pulls out the filter tray, finds a flower and a thank you card. Amber is thrilled that she could have her test results within an hour. As she puts the pieces together, Amber decides it must have been Erica behind a plan to drug Amber, ruin her marriage. Taylor warns Amber to be careful, because she has no proof, but Amber is certain that Erica is behind everything that's happened to her. Rick is upset as it becomes clear that Amber isn't showing up for the meeting, but he invites Erica to sit in. Whip outlines his marketing plan aimed at teens. Erica picks one up herself after everyone leaves. Erica admits to Rick that Amber called, but she didn't tell him at the time because he was in such a good mood.

Ziggy is cleaning up Lance's apartment, has just come across a wad of money. Taylor questions Ziggy, he reveals that Lance had money problems, said he'd do anything for cash. Erica reveals to Sheila that she thinks she's been really good for Rick & Little Eric. She believes that she can show Rick what an open & honest relationship can really be like. Sheila advises Erica not to underestimate Amber because she might try to turn Rick against her. Amber explains to Rick that she wasn't drunk at the victory party, she'd been drugged! Amber lays out her case against Erica, then admits that her drug test was inconclusive. Rick finds her explanation too far-fetched. He admits that Erica has a crush on him, but doesn't think that means she would plot against Amber. When Rick informs Erica about Amber's accusation, Erica thinks that Amber is out of her mind. Amber is more certain than ever that Erica is part of a plot to break up Amber's marriage.

Sheila tries to hide her panic when Ziggy tells her that Taylor was snooping around Lance's apartment. Ziggy informs Sheila that the cash she gave Lance is still sitting in his room. Sheila realizes she needs to get the money back and asks Ziggy for the key. When Amber explains to Taylor that Rick didn't believe her, Taylor suggests that maybe she should have kept her suspicions to herself. Taylor tells Amber about going to Lance's apartment. Amber is grateful for Taylor's help. Taylor's sure that someone was taking advantage of Amber's history and past mistakes. Erica asks Rick why Amber hates her so much. Rick tries to explain that Amber's jealous of Erica's time with Rick and Little Eric. Erica says that Amber keeps lying to Rick because he keeps falling for her lies. Erica pleads with Rick not to let Amber fool him again. Erica heads out to confront Amber, angry about her accusations. Sheila has just put the money in a bag when she hears Taylor's voice from the doorway.

Sheila hides her face in her hands and pretends to sob as if she is a bereaved friend of Lance's. Taylor is moving closer to Sheila, hoping to get some information about Lance, when Ziggy appears. Ziggy orders Taylor to leave again. Sheila is concerned that Taylor will keep snooping around until she finds out what really happened with Amber & Lance. Bridget is incredulous when Rick tells her about Amber's theory. Rick admits it's far-fetched, but thinks it's worth looking into. When Bridget hears that Erica is confronting Amber, she worries that things could get ugly. Erica can't believe Amber is accusing her not only of setting her up at the party, but of somehow being involved in Lance's murder. Erica steps in front of Amber when she says that she's going home to her husband and son. Erica insists that Rick loves her, and he's not going to listen to any more of Amber's lies. When Amber pulls free of Erica's grasp, Erica falls backwards. Erica hits her head and is knocked unconscious.

Sheila & Massimo meet again at Las Olas. Massimo can tell that Sheila can be a dangerous person when she wants to be, but Sheila insists only when she needs to be. Bridget admits to C.J. that her summer isn't turning out at all the way she planned. She had hoped for a trip to Hawaii. C.J. goes into action, planning a private luau for two, but Darla is surprised that C.J. plans to set Bridget up with his friend, Scott. Darla wants C.J. to admit that he's falling for Bridget. Bridget overhears them talking about the date, thinks C.J. is about to ask her out. Erica finally regains consciousness at the hospital. Amber tries to tell Rick that she didn't mean for this to happen. Rick explains to Erica that she has to stay overnight, offers to call her mother. Sheila rushes out when she hears from Erica. She's angry when she hears that Amber was responsible. Amber tries to explain what happened, but Rick orders her to go back to Taylor, get some help.

Sheila asks the nurse what happened to her daughter. Bridget tells Betsy that she overheard C.J. talking about a 'dream date'. When C.J. points Bridget out to him, Scott is more than willing to go along with C.J.'s plan. He wonders why C.J. isn't taking her out himself, but C.J. responds that he isn't ready to date. Rick promises to stay at Erica's bedside as long as she wants him to. Taylor arrives and Amber points out Rick as he comforts Erica. Amber shares her suspicions that Erica is somehow connected to Lance's death, pointing out that Erica is the one who stands to gain everything that Amber is losing. C.J. asks Bridget if she has plans for tomorrow night. Thinking Sheila is Erica's nurse, he informs her that Erica's mother hasn't shown up and he'd like to stay there with her. Sheila excuses herself when the doctor comes in and lets Rick know that Erica will be released tomorrow. Sheila approaches Amber and hisses at her to stay away from Erica and never go near her again.

Erica is released, Rick offers to take her home. Erica is irritated with her mother for never coming to the hospital. Amber informs Taylor that Erica is trying to cause problems for Rick and her. After a phone call from James, Taylor explains to Amber that she doesn't think James ever recovered from losing Mary. Taylor imagines that it must be awful for James to know that someone like Sheila is raising his daughter. Sheila is delighted to hear that Erica will be recuperating at Rick's, advises her not to rush to get back on her feet. Erica admits to Rick what a mystery her father is to her. Darla helps C.J. set up, but she still thinks the blind date is a bad idea. She tells C.J. that it's obvious he is the one Bridget wants to go out with, but C.J. insists that the last thing Bridget needs in her life is a guy like him. Bridget is thrilled with the set up in the back room with all the Hawaiian decorations, but is stunned when Scott arrives and announces that he's her date.

While lamenting to Dr. Cooper that he was not able to save Taylor Forrester, Mark flashes back to a conversation he had with his mother before he came to town, where Margo expressed her concern that Mark would get his heartbroken if he was coming to L.A. to get to know his father, Clarke.

As the Forresters and the Spectras gather to pay their respects to Taylor, Stephanie tries to comfort her grief-stricken father Jack. When Jack sees Brooke show up to the funeral on Ridge's arm he explodes; his daughter is barely in the ground and Brooke is already trying to move in on her husband!
Stephanie tells Bridget that Ridge can never find out that Massimo is his father, but Bridget feels like she's betraying him by lying.
Stephanie is both shocked and disgusted when Brooke shows up in a motorboat wearing the show-stopping wedding gown.
Before the winner can be announced, Ridge takes the stage and dedicates his success to his father, Eric. Massimo can't stand watching his son salute another man, and goes to visit his father's grave.
Macy is heartbroken that she has had to leave without even being able to say goodbye to Sally, and accuses Adam of trying to keep her from Thorne.
Bridget prepares to leave Ridge's home and packs her things, telling Stephanie that she can no longer live with Ridge and lie to him.
Stephanie can't believe that Brooke is dictating policy in Ridge's house like she is already in residence. Stephanie reminds Brooke that it is Ridge's house, not hers.
While Ridge worries that Bridget has left because of something he has done, Brooke tries to regain control by calling Catherine the nanny to come and look after the children.
When C.J. probes Bridget about her reasons for not wanting to move back in with Ridge, he figures that since she loves the children, it's Ridge she's trying to get away from.
Adam tries to convince Macy to forget about her past with Thorne, and in an effort to start over with his beloved, Lorenzo asks her to marry him.
Thorne is initially shocked to discover that Sally plans to tell C.J. that Macy is alive, but soon realises that Sally is right, and C.J. is there best chance to convince her to come home.
While Macy and Lorenzo exchange their wedding vows, Sally first blasts her daughter, then cries for her, before suffering a massive heart attack.
Brooke and Ridge prepare for bed, each preparing to sleep in a different room, when Ridge suddenly kisses Brooke passionately.
Bridget is horrified when she awakens from a dream in which she is married to Ridge, and they are raising Ridge's children together.
Stephanie realises that Brooke is up to her old tricks again and calls her on it, not realising the Bridget is listening just outside the door.
Macy is shocked when she and Lorenzo return from their honeymoon to learn that Sally has had a heart attack, and Adam tells her she should go to Los Angeles to see her.
Massimo deliberately goads a drunken Deacon, telling him that he'll never win Brooke by being a fool. Deacon says he can't interfere or Brooke will brand him the bad guy.
Amber and Rick wait on tenterhooks for Eric's decision, and Amber is thrilled when Eric likes her new sketches and agrees to give her a shot if she busts her butt.
Sally tells Macy that unless she is willing to stay permanently she wants her to go, and Macy agrees to stay just as C.J. barges into the room and is shocked to see his 'dead' sister.
C.J. is ecstatic to have his sister alive and back in his life, and feels no anger -- he, Clarke, Sally, and Darla welcome Macy's new husband with open arms.
Ridge asks Tricia for her advice on Brooke when she comes over looking for news on Thorne, and although Tricia encourages him to make his own decision, she's not sure if Brooke is the right one.
After being threatened by Eric yet again, Deacon decides he's tired of playing the game by the Forrester rules -- he interrupts Ridge's proposal with Brooke to reveal that he is Hope's father.
Amber is shocked to see the X-rating on 'Ambrosia Undressed', and watches the tape in horror. She immediately phones Rudy, demanding answers as to how this tape even got out.
Ridge cannot hide his disgust that Brooke would betray Bridget by sleeping with Deacon, and Brooke tries desperately to convince Ridge that she only slept with Deacon because she couldn't have him.
A tearful Brooke tells Eric and Stephanie that Deacon told Ridge the truth, and Stephanie tells her that it's all for the best, because lies can only hurt people.
Thorne creates a media furor over Macy's return, believing that it's the only way to keep her in town. He calls her in the middle of it all, assuring her he loves her.
Massimo finds a cigar-smoking Deacon at his desk who assures him that he's taken care of Brooke, and muses that Massimo destroyed Brooke and Ridge to gain points with Stephanie.
Brooke wants Bridget to explain why she didn't defend her with Ridge and isn't trying to help her get him back, and Bridget can't believe her mother is trying to get her to lie for her.
Thorne tells Macy that they're meant to be together and begs her to leave Lorenzo, proposing marriage. Macy tells him that he's just using the same arguments Brooke did years earlier.
Amber tearfully tries to explain that she was just a child when she made that video with Rudy back in Furnace Creek, but Rick is disappointed and Eric is furious.
Massimo arrives with a surprise for the kids (floor seats for the Lakers), and when Ridge is out of the room, Mass tells Brooke to leave, and to go destroy someone else's life.
After hearing that Thomas has called out for Bridget, Mass heads over to her place, but before he can explain what's happened Stephanie tells him Bridget isn't going anywhere with him.

Brooke acknowledges to Ridge that she feels responsible for Thomas's condition, but Ridge isn't interested in hearing her apologies. He tells her that they can't hash this out between them right now. His first priority needs to be his son, and hers should be her daughter.

Macy is shocked and horrified when Thorne produces paperwork proving that they are still married because they never actually filed the divorce papers due to her 'death'. Thorne is determined to make her his wife in more than name only, but Macy reminds him that she wants Lorenzo, not him.

After making arrangements with Bill to have Bridget appointed to his pharmaceutical program, Stephanie tells Eric that she's found a way to let Bridget lead her own life. But rather than be pleased at the thought of going to Copenhagen, Bridget thinks Stephanie is trying to get rid of her.

Massimo visits Ridge, and is pleased to hear how much Ridge likes Bridget, and how glad he is that Bridget was there for Thomas. Massimo begins to think that maybe his plan to hook them up will work, and he is furious to learn that Bridget may leave Los Angeles.

Sally begs Gladys for help in finding a way that they can check out Thorne's living arrangements in disguise, just so that they can verify Tricia's role in his life. Tricia realises it's them in the workman's overalls, and stages a sexually explicit conversation with Thorne on the phone.

Desperate to keep Bridget from leaving town in an effort to keep Brooke from landing Ridge again, Massimo tells Ridge that he, and not Eric, is his father, and that Bridget is leaving town because she knows the truth and she has fallen in love with him.

Bridget calls Brooke and is hurt when Ridge answers. Bridget doesn't answer at first, but does and Ridge hopes that she's not hurt. Bridget assures that it's all right. After meeting with Deacon, Massimo calls Captain Dominick Payne, but the call is short-lived after an explosion occurs on the ship that Dominick is on.

Thorne and Macy revel in finding their way back to each other. Darla is devastated to hear Thorne's message on her answering machine telling her that he and Macy are back together. Massimo tells Ridge about the tanker accident and blames Captain Payne for the incident. Bridget prepares to go to Mexico to help with an injured Dominick Payne.

Ridge and Massimo discuss the tanker accident, which segues into a discussion on how Eric would react should he ever learn that Ridge is not his son. Darla puts up a brave front as Macy tells her how happy she and Thorne are to be back together. In Mexico, the injured ship's captain wears a Marone ring as Bridget brings his mother in to see him.

Darla's heart breaks as Macy and Thorne can't stop talking about their love for each other. Rick and Amber toast April's good fortune, but Rick realises Amber is also a little bit jealous. April runs into Deacon and is thrilled when he manages to negotiate a better contract for her upcoming musical gig.

April shares with Rick her encounter with Deacon, and he warns her to stay away from him. Jackie worries about Dominick down in Mexico, and Bridget tries to reassure the worried woman. Massimo heads to Mexico on the corporate jet, determined to punish Captain Payne. Brooke and Ridge spend some time together.

Jackie talks with Bridget about Dominick's condition, and is obviously reluctant to encounter Massimo Marone directly. Deacon introduces April to Cruz Nunez, an old friend of his who is hosting an upcoming variety show. Massimo confronts Dominick in his room, calling him Nick, and blames him for the accident. Stephanie stops by to see Ridge with gifts.
When Nick admits his disbelief that Brooke could even consider a reunion with Ridge after finding him in a clinch with Bridget, Brooke told Nick that she and Ridge had an unshakable bond.
Bridget remembers when Taylor told her always to love, no matter what the cost, and wonders if Taylor could have been foreseeing a relationship between her and Ridge.

Bridget goes to Stephanie looking for help to find her father, but when Stephanie learns that Eric took off because he caught Bridget and Ridge together, Stephanie blasts her former step-daughter, telling her she is just like her mother.

Seeing how upset he is at the situation between his daughter and the man formerly known as his son, Jackie offers Eric a shoulder to cry on, but Nick is upset when he learns that Jackie let Eric spend the night.

After going into a litany of the things she has done to Bridget in the past, including putting her second to a long list of men, not giving her the attention she deserved, and sleeping with her husband, Brooke tells Bridget that her ridiculous infatuation with Ridge has to end.

Ridge is angry when Nick tells him he should stay away from both Bridget and Brooke. Nick says Ridge had his chance with Brooke, and his relationship with Bridget, his former half-sister who he thought was his daughter for a number of years, is just plain wrong.

Thorne is stunned to learn that both Ridge and Eric have turned their backs on Stephanie, but embraces his mother. When he asks Eric to forgive her, Eric refuses despite the fact that Stephanie had no idea Ridge wasn't his son, and tells Thorne that he is now his oldest son.

Although Jackie tries to assure Stephanie that she isn't trying to add to her troubles, Stephanie still wants Jackie to pack up and leave. Later Jackie assures Eric that nothing will make her turn her back on him, for which he is grateful.

Stephanie is surprised when Amber does not turn against her for her deceptions, but rather encourages the older woman that despite Jackie's presence in his life, Eric will come back to her. Darla agrees to allow an excited Macy to adopt her baby, and tells Thorne this will be the best thing for their child.

Darla tells Macy that the baby's father is a happily married man and she doesn't want to ruin his life, and Macy realises that Thorne is actually the father. Thorne tries to explain, but Macy isn't listening. Amber tells Jackie that she's going out, and the other woman better be gone when she gets back. Amber is shocked to come face to face with Jackie as she prepares to meet with Fenmore. Eric tells Stephanie that she's starting to act just like Brooke.

Bridget is rushed to the hospital after becoming a casualty in Ridge and Eric's argument. Sally rips into Thorne after Macy tells her that he is the father of Darla's baby. Nick tells Brooke she'll regret it if she lets Ridge play her against her daughter.

Deacon is touched by what Macy has to say at an AA meeting and gives her his card, suggesting that they keep in touch. Sally is furious with Darla and fires her, warning her to stay away from her family. Bridget tells her mother she can't walk away from Ridge and the children, but when Ridge walks into her room he says she must.

Amber and Rick argue over Ridge and Bridget's relationship, telling him that Ridge is on the market since Brooke called off the wedding. They later make up. Ridge and Bridget agree that despite their good intentions, too many people were hurt by their relationship and needs to end. She asks him to say goodbye to the children for her.

Macy is surprised when Deacon tells her that he is the father of both Hope's daughter Brooke, and Rick and Amber's son Little Eric, and encourages him to get his children back. Jackie is upset to overhear Ridge telling Eric that Brooke is just using Nick to get over him. Brooke and Nick enjoy a night out, and share a passionate kiss.

Deacon is devastated when Jonathan visits, at Rick's bequest, to remind him that he gave up his rights and is not allowed to see his son. Amber tries in vain to get Rick to let up on Deacon. Sally takes great pleasure in informing Stephanie that Thorne got Darla pregnant. Thorne reluctantly signs the annulment papers after Macy begs him to let her go.

Bridget warns Nick that Brooke is probably just using him to make Ridge jealous, like she has with every other man in the past. Ridge attempts to convince Brooke to give them another chance and kisses her, but Brooke pushes him away. Deacon tells Macy about his custody woes with Little Eric, and Macy offers to help.

Nick is confused when Eric suggests he worry about Massimo, as his mother has never met the man. Jackie is shocked to realise that her husband was blackmailing Massimo to stay away, and the two are saddened for all the years they lost. Brooke lays down some ground rules for Ridge.

Nick has a hard time believing that he is Massimo's son and initially tries to return the Marone family ring, but Massimo finally gets through to him. Brooke misunderstoods a moment she witnesses between Ridge and Brooke and turns to Nick, telling him that Jackie is doing better.

Brooke believes she is alone in the house after Ridge drops her off, but finds that he has set up a romantic night for them. He makes his best attempts at seducing her, but she rebuffs him. Nick is disappointed when it doesn't seem like Jackie is coming out of her coma, but Massimo tries to convince him to think positively. Stephanie wonders if Brooke and Nick are romantically involved.

Macy helps Deacon find a home that will improve his situation in a custody battle, and full of gratitude, he kisses her. Brooke is upset to learn that Nick is Massimo's son because she thought she was finally free of Ridge. Thorne tells Ridge that he and Macy are finished.

Eric rushes out of the restaurant after hearing Massimo announce his wedding plans to Jackie, and she quickly follows him. Stephanie is shocked to learn that Nick is Massimo's son with Jackie. Ridge makes another attempt to win Brooke over while Bridget asks Nick to let Brooke be happy with Ridge.

Despite Clarke's pleas, Sally refuses to rehire Darla after the way she betrayed Macy, but things go from bad to worse when Clarke hires Gladys as her replacement, and Gladys' pet skunk gets spray-happy.

Darla begs Sally for her forgiveness, then is stunned when Thorne joins her at the ultrasound and the two bond while seeing their baby. Jackie is pleased that Nick and Brooke's relationship continues to flourish and tells Brooke that she would welcome having her in the family.

Bridget tries to convince Stephanie to stop trying to keep Brooke and Ridge apart, telling her that she will only end up hurting the children. Deacon and Thorne get physical with each other when Deacon tells Thorne that he's already ruined Macy's life with his betrayal. Ridge pushes Brooke to start thinking about a future for them together.

Macy receives an invitation to a private dinner, convinced it's from Deacon, but is shocked to see that Thorne has gone all-out in a last ditch effort to win her back. Deacon attempts to convince C.J. that he loves Macy and won't do anything to hurt her, but C.J. refuses to support their wedding.
Stephanie is thrilled when she realises that her new next door neighbor is Samantha Kelly, their former neighbor who had absolutely adored Ridge when she was younger.

As Nick promises not to ruin the day, Ridge reveals to him that they are not only announcing the new company at the press conference, but also that he plans to officially propose to Brooke. When he drops to one knee to make the proposal, an angry Stephanie bursts in, determined to stop her son from making (in her mind) a horrible mistake.

Amber accuses Bridget of lying about her, and tells her not to talk about her to Oscar and Deacon. Bridget says she'll do whatever necessary to stop Amber from hurting people she loves. Deacon finds the two arguing, and asks Amber to move out. Stephanie and Nick talk about Ridge and Brooke, and Stephanie admits that her outlook on Brooke has changed. She honestly believes Brooke is a different person now, and really loves Ridge. Brooke can't believe that Ridge got out of there alive, and Ridge explains to Brooke that it was Anna. Anna says that she lost her family to the foundary, and wouldn't let Ridge die.

Massimo, Nick, and Stephanie are shocked and overjoyed to see Ridge alive and well, as they prepare to leave. Ridge is just happy to be back, and hopes to start a family with Brooke, who catches Nick's eye as she realises that her next child may not be Ridge's. Amber can't believe she was kicked out by Deacon, and starts to wonder if maybe people like Bridget are right, and she's just no good. Oz tries to cheer her up, assuring her that if she were no good, he never would have hired her. Sally is trying to put on a brave face for a comatose Macy until she sees an article about the reopening of Ozzz, and vows to stop it.

Sally tells Oz that his re-opening of the club so soon is an insult to Macy. He tries to convince her that he can't afford not to re-open. Bridget defends Oz to Sally, but after she leaves admits that she doesn't think he should re-open. Much to Amber's delight, he says he's going ahead as scheduled. Nick tells his mother that he's going to leave town. She realises it's because he can't bear to watch Brooke with Ridge, but will never interfere. She begs him to stay so he can be there for the wedding. Thorne is equally incensed to hear of the club re-opening, but rather than confront Oz, goes with Darla to a sonogram.

The Forresters celebrate Ridge's safe return, and everyone is shocked to see Stephanie embrace Brooke and welcome her to the family. They're equally shocked to learn Nick plans to leave town. Brooke goes to talk to Nick, and tells him that she wants to tell Ridge they slept together, but Nick says he can never find out. Sally, Clarke, Deacon, Thorne, Darla, and Bridget all go to Ozzz to convince Oz not to re-open the club, and they're all shocked to see that Oz has turned it into a tribute for Macy.

Nick begs Brooke not to tell Ridge that they slept together. Ridge, meanwhile, heads to say goodbye to Nick, and becomes suspicious when he finds Nick and Brooke together, and wants to know what's going on. Oscar introduces Sally, and announces that the club is being sold, and proceeds will go to a charity being launched in Macy's name. Amber glares at him as he kisses Bridget. Stephanie is shocked to see just how much Brooke cares for Ridge.

Sally is furious when she learns Brooke told Ridge everything, which negates her blackmail. As Bridget and Deacon share a passionate moment, a furious Eric bursts into the room. Brooke is desperate to get to Stephanie with the truth before Sally does.

Eric is furious to discover that Deacon keeps a loaded gun in the house, and that the safety isn't even on. As Deacon and Eric struggle over the gun, it goes off. Darla continues to defend Deacon, stating that he deserves the same chance she got. Thorne reminds her that she carries the true Forrester heir. Stephanie reassures Samantha that nothing will turn her against Brooke again, but that's before what Brooke tells her starts to sink in.

Stephanie has trouble accepting that Brooke and Nick slept together down in Callixa. Brooke swears she believes Ridge to be her baby's father, but will undergo a test to know for sure. Sally is at the hospital with Darla, and admits that part of the reason she is there is to look into Brooke's story. She learns about the CVS test. Eric swears to Lt. Baker that it was an accident. Mark tells Bridget that they got the bullet out, but Deacon may be paralysed.

Deacon is thrilled when Stephanie brings Little Eric to him, until he realises that he has no feeling in his legs. He breaks down after Bridget gives him the news. Lt. Baker comes to arrest Eric. Jonathan tells him he'll do his best, but the story he's told doesn't make him look good.

When Stephanie realises that Sam still loves Ridge, she encourages her to tell Ridge the truth. Sam does, wanting Ridge to know that he has options other than a life on the edge with Brooke. Jackie asks Ridge to step aside if the baby turns out to belong to Nick...she doesn't want him to take her son's child the way he has taken the woman Nick loves. While Stephanie contemplates Sam and Ridge's future, Jackie is convinced that Nick and Brooke belong together.

Eric wants Bridget to ask Deacon to sign an affadavit claiming that the shooting was an accident. After Deacon has a pep talk with Ozzy, Bridget offers him her total support. Stephanie encourages Ridge to remember the reason why the paternity of that child is currently in jeopardy, but Ridge says he will never give up on Brooke. Massimo feels that Brooke's actions will destroy his family, but Jackie reminds him that either way, that child is his grandchild.

Nick attacks Massimo for his insinuation that Brooke is a woman of loose morals. He admits that he loves Brooke, but for her sake, hopes that child belongs to Ridge. When Stephanie tells Sally that she won't do anything to drive a wedge between Brooke and Ridge because she can't do that to her family, Sally vows to do it for her. Deacon is pleased to know that Oscar is jealous about his relationship with Bridget, and vows to take her from him as soon as he's well again.

As they await the results of the CVS test, Ridge reminds Nick that he blames him completely for what happened, and states that once the test proves that he (Ridge) is the father, he wants Nick to stay out of his and Brooke's lives forever. As the results are about to head to the lab, Sally waits, determined to get her way and to punish Brooke for everthing she did to Macy over the years.
While Bridget introduces Oscar to her family, Deacon receives a diamond engagement ring he ordered for Bridget.
As Stephanie assures Eric that Bridget will do the right thing and turn away from Deacon, Oscar asks her to marry him.
Sally gets a computer hacker (Marv) to help her figure out how to break into the lab computers to see the paternity test results.
Bridget goes to the hospital to tell Deacon that she and Oscar are engaged but before she gets a chance, he pops the question.
Sally is busted before she can look at the paternity results. Later, Dr. Paxson calls Brooke and Ridge to tell them that she has the answer they're looking for.

After receiving a call from Dr. Paxson, Ridge and Brooke head down to her office, where they run into Nick (who called the doctor and learned the results were in), Jackie (who was with Nick at the time), Stephanie (whom Eric had ordered to make amends with Brooke), and Eric (who was just plain curious). Once there they all waited on tenterhooks. First Dr. Paxson revealed that Brooke was carrying a boy, then prepared to reveal who the father was.
All are shocked as Dr. Paxson reveals that Nick, not Ridge, is the father of Brooke's baby.

As Bridget tells Deacon that she can never love him because of what he has done to her in the past, she shows him the ring that Oscar gave to her. Meanwhile, Oscar informs Amber that he and Brooke are engaged. Brooke is shocked that Ridge still wants to be with her after everything that has happened.

Brooke tells Nick that she and Ridge will raise that child as though Ridge is the father, but Nick informs Brooke that he is not going to walk away from his child. Ridge tells Stephanie that as far as he's concerned that child is his, and Stephanie tries to steer him toward Samantha.

Ridge tells Nick that he and Brooke will raise that baby without any interference from him, and reveals that he plans to adopt the child. Nick tells Ridge that he will never give up on his child. Stephanie breaks down in Brooke's arms after begging Brooke to put her child above her own desires.

Darla and Thorne are all smiles as Darla gives birth to their daughter. Wanting to remember her friend Macy Alexander, Darla names her infant daughter Alexandria. Ridge begs Brooke not to do this to him, not to leave him. He tells her they can get through anything together, but she says she has to do this. Stephanie sees Nick, who is shocked that Stephanie isn't blaming everything on Brooke. Actually, Stephanie is proud of Brooke.

Ridge laments the loss of Brooke and the child that could have been his to a sympathetic Samantha. Oscar is pleased that Massimo considers him one of the family, not realising Mass is using him to get back at the Forresters. Sally admits to trying to tamper with the paternity results, but swears she never got near them.
His first day on the job, Oscar plays hooky to have a picnic with Bridget. Massimo spots Jackie and Eric in a compromising position.
Jackie and Eric say their goodbyes to each other as Massimo vows to do anything, even use Oscar, to take Eric down.

Jackie heads over to tell Nick about Dr. Paxson's death. Before she can tell him about Paxson's call to her about the test results, she sees how Nick and Brooke have bonded, and opts to wait. Caitlin introduces Thomas to her father, Hector, and Thomas is surprised to learn that Hector believes Caitlin is a waitress.
Stephanie consoles Brooke when she admits that, although she believes Nick will be a good father, she will always miss Ridge.
Nick brings Hope with him to pick up Brooke from the hospital, and is awed by the ultrasound photographs he sees of his son.
Brooke tries to sleep after a visit from Rick where he encourages her to pursue a life with Nick, but is awakened by a vision of Taylor.
Ridge can't believe it when he sees Taylor there in front of him, and is humbled when she tells him how happy she is that he has Brooke.
Ridge seeks answers from Taylor's spirit, and she tells him that she is glad he has Brooke, then the two watch their sleeping children before Taylor tells Ridge goodbye.
Jackie is less than thrilled to see Taylor, especially when Taylor tells her that as long as she keeps the secret about the paternity tests, she can never rest.
Deacon's anxiety for the debut of Sharpe's Designs is well-placed as Eric has nothing good to say about his former son-in-law's company.
At the Café Russe Bar, Deacon uses what little information he gleaned from eavesdropping to trick Jackie into spilling the beans.
Thomas tries to placate Hector Ramírez by telling him that it's an honor that Caitlin was hired on at Forrester, but Hector is far more worried about Stephanie recognizing him.
Samantha is absolutely devastated when she returns from lunch with Stephanie to find out that her beloved Pucci is dead. Bridget does her best to comfort her devastated friend.
Ridge begs Brooke to leave town with him, but even though she misses having him in her life, she is committed to a life with Nick and the baby.

Priscilla and Sam visit the Forresters for dinner, and Priscilla is horrified when Samantha tells the family that Pucci was given to her to help her get over the death of her daughter when she was a teen.
Eric, Stephanie and Rick try to convince Amber and Sally not to leave the company, but Amber is adamant that it is time that they strike out on their own.
Deacon surprises Jackie when, instead of blackmailing her about the paternity tests, he simply tells her he wants the chance to prove he can make it on his own in business.
Ridge offers Samantha a shoulder as she tells him the whole story about the baby girl she lost all those years ago, and the real reason she left Los Angeles.
Nick proposes marriage to Brooke, but Brooke is torn on how exactly to respond. He encourages her to think about what he has said, and to keep the ring while she does.
Hector tries to comfort Amber over the loss of her apartment and all of her belongings, but she lashes out when he suggests she contact her family.
Although initially Deacon was prepared to expose Jackie to both Brooke and Ridge, he was swayed by her saying that she believed in him.
